newsitem.title: USA: American Healthcorp unit spinoff delayed.
newsitem.headline: American Healthcorp unit spinoff delayed.

text.p: American Healthcorp said Tuesday it has delayed plans to spin off AmSurg Corp because of tax complications.

The company said it has been advised that the U.S. Internal Revenue Service will not permit the transaction to be completed on a tax-free basis. American Healthcorp owns 59 percent of AmSurg common stock.
American Healthcorp had proposed spinning off AmSurg by distributing all of its AmSurg stock to American Healthcorp stockholders, it said.
The company said it is submitting to the IRS a new structure for the plan which it hopes will result in a reversal of the agency's current stance.

The delay in the distribution should not have an adverse effect upon either AmSurg or American Healthcorp's other unit, Diabetes Treatment Centers of America Inc, company chairman and chief executive Thomas Cigarran said in a written statement.
